content: Don't miss this trailer for You Can See Everything, an upcoming documentary from A24, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim. You Can See Everything is the true events of notorious Silicone Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes, 34 days before she's sent to prison, she invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. This is what they captured. You Can See Everything comes to cinemas this October!
